result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 2 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    p = next(( (r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5), None)
    if p is None: return []
    # follow the colored object attached to the marker, using the nonzero color
    q = [(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc) for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))]
    q = [(r,c) for r,c in q if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    seen=set(q)
    while q:
        r,c=q.pop()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc] not in (0,5) and (rr,cc) not in seen:
                seen.add((rr,cc)); q.append((rr,cc))
    if not seen: return []
    r0=min(r for r,c in seen); r1=max(r for r,c in seen)
    c0=min(c for r,c in seen); c1=max(c for r,c in seen)
    return [[grid[r][c] if (r,c) in seen else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]"}
